fundamentals.REVERSE_SPLIT_NOTE: Upland executed a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, effective 2026-06-17 (charter amendment filed 2026-06-03), to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance. catalysts.headline: Confirmed: deadline for Upland to regain Nasdaq compliance with the $15 million minimum market value of publicly held shares (MVPHS) requirement. Upland received the deficiency notice 2026-07-31 (180-day cure period running to 2027-01-27). This is a SEPARATE, still-open issue from the earlier minimum-bid-price deficiency, which was already resolved in July 2026 via the 1-for-10 reverse split.
catalysts.impact: A notice of deficiency, not an immediate delisting; if uncured by 2027-01-27, Nasdaq will issue a delisting notice, which Upland could appeal to a Hearings Panel with no assurance of success
